summary: Users cannot test standalone activity client flow including the full interceptor chain (tracing, metrics) in TestWorkflowEnvironment without running a real Temporal server. Currently ExecuteActivity bypasses the ClientOutboundInterceptor chain entirely.
userImpact: Users cannot adequately test their ClientOutboundInterceptor implementations for standalone activities without spinning up an actual Temporal server.
rootCause: TestActivityEnvironment.ExecuteActivity calls taskHandler.Execute() directly, bypassing the ClientOutboundInterceptor chain that is normally invoked by the client.
proposedFix: Add ExecuteStandaloneActivity to TestWorkflowEnvironment that sets up header context, calls through the ClientOutboundInterceptor chain, and returns a ClientActivityHandle supporting Get(), Cancel(), and Terminate().
workaround: Spin up a real Temporal server for testing, which is costly and slow.
keyQuote: There is no way to test the full standalone activity client flow (client → interceptor chain → worker) without spinning up a real Temporal server.
